# Release Checklist

- [ ] Version updated.
- [ ] Changelog updated.
- [ ] Plugin validates.
- [ ] Unit and integration tests pass.
- [ ] Windows and Linux CI pass.
- [ ] Security scans pass or findings are accepted explicitly.
- [ ] Secret scan passes.
- [ ] Actions are pinned and permissions minimized.
- [ ] SBOM generated.
- [ ] License inventory generated.
- [ ] Upgrade test passes.
- [ ] Uninstall test passes.
- [ ] Clean-install test passes.
- [ ] Checksums generated.
- [ ] Attestation or signing completed where configured.
- [ ] Release notes prepared.
- [ ] Public publication approval obtained.
